 1 / 7 If the week gone by was a results-heavy one, this one promises to be heavier than the last. Over 350 companies will be reporting their quarterly numbers during the course of Monday to Saturday, with over 70 results each on Tuesday and Wednesday, while over 90 results on Thursday. Nifty names like ITC, Hindalco, Tata Steel, and others will be reporting their numbers this week, along with broader market names such as NALCO, MobiKwik, ideaForge, Tata Chemicals, NSE, BSE, LIC, and many others.
